title: 目標達成の後に・落星

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Phew… I did it, Trainer. With your help, I've made it through the Classics season.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the Kikuka Sho passes, I continue supporting Meisho Doto in all her endeavors.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I could only come this far thanks to you, Trainer… Along with Opera O and Ayabe.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I don't have half of the passion those two have but… maybe it's time…
choice_data_list: To aim for a bigger goal?
To aim for a bigger goal?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, no, that's not what I had in mind…
choice_data_list: Then, try saying it loud and clear!
Then, try saying it loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No, no, no, I couldn't possibly do that! My heart would jump out of my chest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She still lacks the courage to make goals for herself. More time is still needed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wham!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The silence of my office dissolves immediately with a loud noise. I look over to see the door kicked wide open.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Doto! Trainer! Have you two heard the news?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabe… she's…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rumble, rumble… Ssss…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You have… inflammation in your legs.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: And… you don't know when you can get back to racing?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's what the doctor said.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I noticed something was… off after the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But, why? Why… you? Oh, Ayabe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nobody utters a word, not even T.M. Opera O. The silence in the room is stifling.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: This is… too much. Something like this shouldn't be allowed to happen…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ayabe, you're so… You're so—Sniff!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I feel… like I've been set free a little.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't have to run, for now. And no running means… I don't have to win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't have to force myself to look up at the sky anymore.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But… But!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto, you can't change what has happened. We all need a moment of respite sometimes.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Be well, Ayabe. I am certain that for you, this is but a small obstacle in a greater path. However…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This means our fight with the generation prior—the Ultimate Generation—will take a turn for the worse.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: With our valiant trio whittled down to two, I can only imagine my foes will have me surrounded.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O laments the approaching future, her last words a whisper.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But alas, this is fate. All we can do is wait, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: This can't be happening… Ayabe… T.M. Opera too…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Not my… two dearest friends… Sniffle… Waaaaahh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang! Dash!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (Why, why, whywhywhywhy?)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (Why would the gods do this? To someone so kind like Ayabe?)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (She's done so many things for me and Opera O. And yet!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I can't do anything! I can't give anything back! Waaaahh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eventually, the rain clears. I find Meisho Doto alone, standing in a daze.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I may be clumsy and wimpy and dumb… But I still tried to come up with something. I thought and thought and thought…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That's how I figured it out—I can't do anything for Ayabe right now.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm not very smart, but that I can at least understand. The things I believed were certain turned out not to be.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Right now isn't good for… Ayabe… It isn't good for Ayabe or Opera O… but I can't… I can't…
choice_data_list: There has to be something you can do, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Surely, there's something you can do… right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What I suddenly say to her sounds almost like a prayer, however…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: There's nothing I can do… for Ayabe…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But maybe… that doesn't apply to everything else.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O could crumble under the competition. If that happens, Ayabe will have nowhere to return.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I have to protect them. No matter what happens or who gets in the way.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: If no one else is there to run alongside Opera O…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I will.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just two short words. But they mark a first for Meisho Doto. She's finally found the fire within.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I may be clumsy, wimpy, and dumb… But…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I know when I'm in someone's debt. I-I have to get stronger—I just have to!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I don't have what it takes right now. My strength, my speed, everything is lacking. That's why…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I have to work my way up, until I'm ready for a spring G1!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We come to a conclusion after a long discussion. Our next goal will be the G2 Nikkei Shinshun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's held in January, which will give us plenty of time to prep for G1s afterwards. The lineup does includes a few heavy-hitter senior runners, though…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I will compete! And I will show you my best run yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The training wheels are off. It's time for Meisho Doto to break out of her shell and grow.
